Title: Azure Stream Analytics: 3 new regions are now generally available

Body.Content:
Azure Stream Analytics is now generally available for customers in 3 new regions:

  • Switzerland North
  • South Africa North
  • West US 3

With this announcement, Stream Analytics is now available in 36 Azure regions worldwide. For more information about local pricing, visit the Azure Stream Analytics pricing webpage.
